# Season & Story

Product key: seasonally
Aliases: Seasonally
Canonical product: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/registry/seasonally
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/seasonally/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/seasonally/ai-conformance.json

## Related product layers

- Evercraft Rewards: Approved local rewards can complement household shopping and seasonal activity discovery without changing grocery evidence rules.
- EventWave: Current local events can feed seasonal adventure discovery while event availability and ticketing remain source-bound.
- Evercraft Home: Traditions and community history can connect to seasonal planning while private household memories remain private.

## Use this capability when the user means

- seasonal family activities
- seasonal recipes for my family
- turn this recipe into a grocery list
- family seasonal traditions
- local seasonal events and adventures
- compare grocery basket prices near me
- cheapest groceries for this recipe

## Authority

public product discovery for seasonal family planning, recipes and household organization; household data and actions remain account-bound

## Boundaries

- live Kroger retailer-price retrieval is held until legitimate server credentials and a bounded real source proof exist
- do not claim Seasonally currently finds the cheapest local grocery basket
- retailer SKU price evidence and grocery-term-to-product matching remain separate evidence states
- promotion eligibility and cross-package unit normalization are not proven
- private household, member, memory, checklist and profile data are not public
- public runtime hostname remains unresolved in the current discovery inventory

## Universal Evercraft routing

Not declared.

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
